name: Skyvern
description: Automates browser-based business workflows with vision LLMs, so tasks run on sites it has never seen without hand-written selectors.
whatItDoes: Runs repetitive web processes such as form filling, data entry, downloads and procurement across many different websites. Operations teams and developers describe the goal, and Skyvern works out the clicks; a visual workflow builder chains several tasks together.
howItWorks: A group of cooperating agents plans the task, inspects the page with a vision-capable model and performs actions through Playwright. It is self-hostable with a local server and web UI, keeps run data in a local SQLite database by default, and also exposes a Playwright-compatible SDK plus a TypeScript client.
